description: This is a Markdown documentation file describing the 'GenericAssertions' class used in Playwright testing framework. It provides comprehensive documentation for assertion methods and properties related to the class, including usage examples, parameters, and behavior.

classes.name: GenericAssertions
classes.description: Provides assertion methods for flexible and deep value comparisons in tests, including equality, type checking, property existence, regex matching, approximate equality, and more.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Makes the assertion check for the opposite condition, enabling negation of assertions.

methods.name: toBe
methods.description: Compares a value with expected using Object.is, with emphasis on reference equality for objects.

methods.name: toBeCloseTo
methods.description: Performs approximate comparison of floating point numbers for near equality.

methods.name: toBeDefined
methods.description: Ensures that a value is not undefined.

methods.name: toBeFalsy
methods.description: Checks if a value is falsy (false, 0, '', null, undefined, NaN).

methods.name: toBeGreaterThan
methods.description: Ensures a number is greater than expected.

methods.name: toBeGreaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Ensures a number is greater than or equal to expected.

methods.name: toBeInstanceOf
methods.description: Checks if a value is an instance of a specified class or constructor.

methods.name: toBeLessThan
methods.description: Ensures a number is less than expected.

methods.name: toBeLessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Ensures a number is less than or equal to expected.

methods.name: toBeNaN
methods.description: Checks if a value is NaN.

methods.name: toBeNull
methods.description: Checks if a value is null.

methods.name: toBeTruthy
methods.description: Checks if a value is truthy.

methods.name: toBeUndefined
methods.description: Checks if a value is undefined.

methods.name: toContain#1
methods.description: Ensures a string contains an expected substring.

methods.name: toContain#2
methods.description: Checks if an Array or Set contains an expected item.

methods.name: toContainEqual
methods.description: Checks if a collection contains an item equal to expected, with deep equality.

methods.name: toEqual
methods.description: Performs deep equality check for value and expected contents.

methods.name: toHaveLength
methods.description: Ensures a value's length matches expected.

methods.name: toHaveProperty
methods.description: Checks for existence of a property at a key path, optionally with an expected value.

methods.name: toMatch
methods.description: Checks if a string matches a regex pattern.

methods.name: toMatchObject
methods.description: Performs deep partial match, allowing extra properties.

methods.name: toStrictEqual
methods.description: Performs deep equality and type comparison, checking keys, array sparseness, and object types.

methods.name: toThrow
methods.description: Executes a function and ensures it throws an error, optionally matching message or type.

methods.name: toThrowError
methods.description: Alias for toThrow.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Matches any object instance created from a constructor or primitive type.

methods.name: anything
methods.description: Matches any value except null and undefined.

methods.name: arrayContaining
methods.description: Matches an array containing all specified elements (subset).

methods.name: arrayOf
methods.description: Matches an array of objects created from a constructor or primitive type.

methods.name: closeTo
methods.description: Performs approximate equality check for numbers with a specified number of decimal digits.

methods.name: objectContaining
methods.description: Matches objects containing specified properties, allowing partial matches.

methods.name: stringContaining
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a specified substring.

methods.name: stringMatching
methods.description: Checks if a string matches a regex pattern.
